training: Per-channel record 0 already explored in prior audit; fixed carrier is its demeaned Hann-window FFT peak in 10–200 kHz after sample 200.
evaluation: Per-channel records 1–99; varying drive-frequency settings, not repeated identical trials. This extension is not blinded, preregistered or independent.
analytic_signal: On unwindowed demeaned post-trigger samples, DFT: retain DC/Nyquist once, double positive bins, zero negative bins. Even N=16184.
filter: Rectangular positive-frequency DFT band within 5000 Hz of fixed carrier. No per-record carrier fitting. Retain complex signal; demodulate by exp(-2pi i fc t), t=(sample_index-200)/fs. No decimation.
endpoint_caveat: Finite DFT assumes periodic extension. Interior guard is a diagnostic choice, not an edge-error certificate; whole-record residual supplies a conservative pointwise bound on finite-DFT truncation anywhere.
phase_floor: Accept a point only if abs(filtered analytic signal) > 10*max_abs(full analytic minus filtered analytic), calculated over the entire post-trigger window. No calibrated instrument noise bound is inferred.
record_gate: Relative signed RMS reconstruction residual <= 0.05 AND >=0.95 of interior points pass phase floor; thresholds are diagnostic design choices, not UD model acceptance.
energy: Envelope squared is a voltage-squared proxy. If C=20 nF, C*abs(envelope)^2/2 is a nominal capacitor-envelope proxy only. No full Hamiltonian, native support, action or cross-device phase calibration.
